get.description:
Upsert/read/delete the single optional external link for one passage or part on a day.

The link is keyed by the content id (passage_id / part_id) since a day allows
at most one link per passage and one per part. The content must already be
assigned to the day.

MarathonListeningPartWrite.description:
Wraps existing write serializer; forces source=MARATHON and practice_test=None.

Marathon parts are not attached to a practice test, but admins may still
label them PART_1 / PART_2 / PART_3 / PART_4 so the frontend can show
"Part 1" etc. The label is optional and not enforced unique within the
marathon pool.

QuestionTypeEnum.description:
* `MCQ_SINGLE` - Multiple Choice - Single Answer
* `MCQ_MULTIPLE` - Multiple Choice - Multiple Answers
* `SENTENCE_COMPLETION` - Sentence Completion
* `SUMMARY_COMPLETION` - Summary Completion
* `TABLE_COMPLETION` - Table Completion
* `FLOW_CHART_COMPLETION` - Flow Chart Completion
* `SHORT_ANSWER` - Short Answer
* `MATCHING_HEADINGS` - Matching Headings
* `TFNG` - True / False / Not Given
* `YNNG` - Yes / No / Not Given
* `MATCH_PARA_INFO` - Matching Paragraph Information
* `LIST_SELECTION` - List Selection
* `CHOOSING_TITLE` - Choosing a Title
* `CLASSIFICATION` - Classification / Matching Features
* `MATCH_SENT_ENDINGS` - Matching Sentence Endings
* `DIAGRAM_COMPLETION` - Diagram Completion
* `MATCHING` - Matching
* `PLAN_MAP_DIAGRAM` - Plan / Map / Diagram Labelling
* `FORM_COMPLETION` - Form Completion
* `NOTE_COMPLETION` - Note Completion
